architecture.cnn: Conv1d(1->32,k=3)+BN+ReLU, Conv1d(32->64,k=3)+BN+ReLU, adaptive-avg-pool(4), FC(256->64)+ReLU+dropout(0.3), FC(64->6); AdamW lr=1e-3 wd=1e-3, 120 epochs, batch 64
architecture.bilstm: BiLSTM(input 1, hidden 32), mean pooling over steps, FC(64->64)+ReLU+dropout(0.3), FC(64->6); same optimiser schedule
architecture.transformer: per-token linear projection of 3 features -> d_model 32, 2 encoder layers (4 heads, FFN 64, dropout 0.2), mean pooling, FC(32->6); same schedule
architecture.protocol: identical repeated stratified 5-fold splits (3 repeats), fold-wise standardisation, no feature selection beyond the 19 canonical columns
